note.note:
I’m ready to create the SOAP clinical note, but I don’t see the visit transcript or the DDx JSON in your message. Please provide both:

- The full visit transcript (doctor–patient conversation).  
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON from the diagnostic agent.

Notes for best results:
- Include any vitals, exam findings, medications, allergies, labs, imaging, and explicit management or follow-up discussed in the visit (if available).
- If medication names are given without dose/route/frequency, that’s fine — I will record them as “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, I will mark “conflict noted” per your instructions.

When you provide those two items I will produce the SOAP note in the exact structure requested.
